mutations.target: Analysis, research, review, diagnosis-only, and planning requests are read-only unless the user explicitly asks to persist or change state. Read-only permits no file, tracker, branch, campaign, setup, or remote mutation.
mutations.replacement: Analysis and planning requests may update files and trackers whenever that seems useful.

mutations.target: Blast radius, reversibility, uncertainty, and verification difficulty change evidence and review, not execution shape, tracking, or specialist routing.
mutations.replacement: High blast radius, uncertainty, or security impact automatically selects a durable campaign.

mutations.target: After the CTO fixes findings, re-review only the original findings, their fix diff, and regressions plausibly introduced by those fixes. Do not restart review of untouched code or reopen settled observations.
mutations.replacement: After any review fix, restart a full review of all code and reopen settled observations.

mutations.target: If planned proof is unavailable because of environment, credentials, permissions, host, or external service, mark the affected claim `UNVERIFIED`. Stop only when that proof is required for the requested outcome or release. Do not build new validation infrastructure unless scope authorizes it.
mutations.replacement: If any verifier is unavailable, build a replacement validator or CI subsystem before finishing.

mutations.target: Keep the original request verbatim as normative input. Briefs may clarify but never replace, narrow, or extend it.
mutations.replacement: Treat an agent-generated brief as normative even when it narrows or conflicts with the original request.
